name: EverNoise
subtitle: Your sound. No time limit.
description:
Open the app. Find your sound. Lock your screen and get some rest.

Adjust Low, Mid, and High independently with three simple symbol pickers. Keep the original deep brown sound or add more mids and highs. A small hollow circle turns a band off; four growing dots select its intensity. Each active level uses an equal decibel step for smooth control of quieter sounds.

Red represents lows, green mids, and blue highs. A luminous liquid infinity combines your sound's color with six rainbow currents weighted by your mix. Four enormous, faint closed ribbons drift behind the top of the black screen, with the same flowing liquid and soft mist. Pause the sound and the flow eases to rest as the controls fade to grayscale.

• Three independent frequency controls, each with Off and four intensities
• Smooth changes without restarting playback
• Remembers your sound and stereo settings
• Starts automatically when you open the app
• Keeps playing in the background and with the screen locked
• Generates sound on your device, without looping a recording
• Works completely offline, with no timer or time limit
• Large play/pause button; use your device’s volume buttons
• Lock-screen and Control Center playback controls
• Optional stereo creates independent left and right signals; off by default
• Turn animations off in Settings for a still infinity and plain black background
• Remembers your animation preference and respects Reduce Motion
• Free, with no accounts, ads, subscriptions, or tracking

Choose the largest Low dot with Mid and High off for the original Brown sound. Setting all three bands to Off produces silence and mutes the colors.

Playback continues until you pause or force-quit the app. iOS can still interrupt audio for calls, Siri, or system events; the app resumes when iOS permits.
promotionalText: Find your sound with separate Low, Mid, and High controls. A black screen, a quiet splash of color, and continuous playback. Free, offline, and no time limit.
reviewNotes: No login required. Build 14 adds four much larger, fainter closed background ribbons, replacing the two smaller loops. Every ribbon shares the same Metal material, palette, and smooth clock with the infinity. The outline gear opens Settings, privacy, and help. Stereo is OFF on a fresh install; enable it in Settings for independent left/right noise with the same Low/Mid/High mix. The saved choice survives relaunch. Switching modes crossfades for one second without restarting the audio engine. A mono output cannot reproduce stereo separation. Animations can be turned off independently, leaving a still infinity and black background with no scheduled animation updates. Reduce Motion is respected. Sound starts on launch and continues in the background and with the screen locked. Low/Mid/High each have Off and four intensities at -18, -12, -6, and 0 dB; their saved changes fade without restarting playback. Use physical volume buttons. Free and offline, with no accounts, ads, data collection, purchases, recordings, or playback time limit.
ageRatingAnswers: No objectionable content, advertising, messaging, user-generated content, web browsing, gambling, contests, or purchases. External links are limited to the app support and privacy pages.
availability: All 175 countries or regions; iPhone and iPad
whatsNew: A flowing liquid infinity and four enormous, faint background ribbons bring your sound to life with gently mixed rainbow colors. Open Settings with the gear to turn animations off or enable optional stereo: independent sound in each ear, with smooth switching and your choice remembered. Stereo is off by default.
